# ScriptSnap

> ScriptSnap is a free Chrome extension that copies and downloads the transcript of any YouTube video in one click. It exports TXT, SRT, VTT, Markdown, CSV and JSON, and adds search, a synced transcript panel, starred lines, video insights and AI prompts for ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini. It runs entirely in the browser, needs no account and uses only the storage permission.

Key facts:
- Price: free, no limits, no ads
- Works on: YouTube videos that have captions, including auto-generated captions
- Browsers: Chrome and Chromium-based browsers (Edge, Brave)
- Privacy: no servers, no analytics, no data collection
- Install: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/scriptsnap/YOUR-EXTENSION-ID
